title: Milk osteopontin alters the infant microbiome to drive DC hematopoiesis and disease tolerance.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GEO GSE306448 (mouse single-cell RNA sequencing plus hashtag-oligo sample barcodes): listed the supplement folder and filelist.txt; downloaded and parsed results.tsv.gz (actually comma-separated: 182,287 cells x cluster, Celltype, Group, UMAP coordinates), barcodes.tsv.gz (182,287 rows) and features.tsv.gz (23,687 genes). Counted 18 cell-type labels and 32 Group strings (4 groups x 2 timepoints, PND10 = postnatal day 10 and 5DPI = 5 days post infection, x 2 tissues, Lung and MLN = mediastinal lymph node, x 2 replicates). Did not download matrix.mtx.gz (803 MB, over the 50 MB cap).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Only the abstract is available (Cell, paywalled, no PMCID, no full text in Europe PMC). What Group1-4 mean (genotype/supplement arms) is not stated in GEO or in the files; microbiome 16S and metabolomics data mentioned in the abstract were not found in any linked repository (BioProject PRJNA1310854 links only this GEO series).

a1_downloadable.note: Checked: GEO files download openly; the full count matrix is 803 MB compressed, so only metadata was recorded for it.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked: the only columns are author cell-type calls and an opaque Group string; the experimental arm (genotype / osteopontin supplement) would have to be decoded from 'Group1-4' with no documentation in GEO.

a3_inputs_present.note: Checked: per-cell gene counts exist (23,687 genes) in the large matrix; not opened.

a4_units_stated.note: Raw UMI (unique molecular identifier) counts in Matrix Market format; standard, units implicit but conventional.

a5_enough_rows.note: Checked: 182,287 cells, but the independent units for any condition label are 32 pooled samples, about 2 per arm-tissue-timepoint; far below 400 independent labelled units.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~3-5 GB sparse in memory for 182k cells x 23.7k genes (estimate)
a6_fits_laptop.note: Feasible with subsetting to highly variable genes; not timed.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Barcodes and results tables agree at 182,287 cells; no paper count available to compare (no full text).

a8_label_provenance.note: Checked: Celltype comes from Louvain clustering (pheno_louvain column) of the same expression data, so predicting it from expression is circular; the treatment-arm label is a real experimental fact but too few replicates.

backbone.name: scGPT / Geneformer (single-cell foundation models; human-trained, mouse requires ortholog mapping)

honest_claim_h3: At best: classifies which of four undocumented mouse treatment groups a lung or lymph-node cell came from, with about two pooled replicates per group, so any signal is confounded with sample batch.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-cell gene expression from neonatal mouse lung and lymph node to predict which feeding or genotype group the mouse belonged to.
plain_idea.train_on: Gene counts per cell for 182,287 cells (verified), from 32 pooled samples across 4 groups, 2 ages, 2 tissues.
plain_idea.predict: The experimental group of the source mouse, known from hashtag barcodes, or the cell type, which the authors assigned by clustering the same expression data.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little: with about two replicates per condition, a classifier would learn sample batch, and cell-type labels are circular.

ml_idea: None viable: per-cell condition classification is confounded by ~2 pooled replicates per arm; cell-type labels are derived from the expression clustering itself.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from the 803 MB compressed matrix and 182,287 x 23,687 dimensions; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count independent biological replicates per condition in the Group column: 2 per arm-tissue-timepoint (done; it kills the project).

verdict_reason: Mouse single-cell atlas with no usable label: cell types are clustering outputs of the same expression (A8), and the treatment arms are undocumented Group codes with about two pooled replicates each (A2, A5). Existing-models search skipped because Part A failed.
